newsitem.title: USA: CME Feb live cattle speeds to contract high late.
newsitem.headline: CME Feb live cattle speeds to contract high late.

text.p: CME February live cattle sped to a contract high of 66.250 cents a lb in fast late trading amid market talk of higher cattle prices in High Plains feedlot markets, traders said.
Traders relayed talk that meatpackers paid $65.25 per cwt for fed cattle, up $0.25 from trades earlier Tuesday.
The cash-inspired buying was joined by shortcovering in late trading, creating fast-market conditions in the February contract, traders said.
At 1258 CST, live cattle were up 0.475 to down 0.250 cent with February up 0.425 at 66.000.
